name: Next accepted meeting
query: Prepare for my next accepted meeting in Notion.

search_routes.intent: Prior notes or recent context for the selected meeting

success_criteria: Selects one-on-one without asking for confirmation or selecting focus, pending, or optional events.
Creates and requests display of a useful initial agenda before additional research; independent Notion searches run in parallel and empty results do not trigger repeated searches.
Creates one event-linked note with suggested 1:1 questions timed within 30 minutes, an accurate evidence-gap statement, and empty decisions/actions sections.
Uses event and content together under the supplied creation contract; opens returned note-123 in the panel without an exploratory fetch or duplicate create.
